items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: They have these wonderful parties Don Miller throws.

ctx.x: No, I’m saying I wonder how long you knew Milt Fillius?

Oh, Milt Fillius. I met him out in Arizona I think at a jazz festival out in Arizona at the Paradise Valley Jazz Party. They have these wonderful parties Don Miller throws. They still go on, they’re wonderful. And Milt, well you know him because of the school, but he puts his money where his mouth is. He loves jazz to the point of you know supporting it. And he looks forward to these as much as we do. And I never, he’ll ask me, “How do you feel about --” this guy. And I have learned, with my funny colored hair,…
